# rvdna / tests / fixtures

Sample 23andMe-format genotype text files used by the rvdna test
suite to validate biomarker / risk scoring and variant handling.

## Files
- `sample-high-risk-cardio.23andme.txt` - High cardiovascular risk
  baseline.
- `sample-low-risk-baseline.23andme.txt` - Low-risk control sample.
- `sample-multi-risk.23andme.txt` - Multiple-risk profile sample.
- `sample-pcsk9-protective.23andme.txt` - Profile with PCSK9
  protective variants.
